what_changed: Annual policy verification: confirmed active rate schedules, category ladders, and payment gateway costs across eBay US, eBay UK, Etsy, Whatnot, TikTok Shop, Depop, and Twitch Bits.
rate_summary: All 2026 fee schedules audited and confirmed active

what_changed: eBay UK completely eliminated selling fees (0% Final Value Fee and £0.00 insertion fee) for private individuals selling in the UK across all categories except Motors. Registered business sellers continue paying standard rates (12.8% + £0.30 plus 20% VAT).
category_impact: Private listings across all consumer categories

what_changed: Depop discontinued its 10% marketplace selling fee for US sellers. Sellers pay 0% selling commission, paying only the standard marketplace payment processing fee of 3.3% + $0.45.
TikTok Shop transitioned standard referral rates from promotional introductory levels (2% to 4%) to a flat 6.0% referral fee per order across most product categories.
rate_summary: 6.0% referral fee standardized across most categories
category_impact: Apparel, beauty, home, and general merchandise

what_changed: Confirmed standard Final Value Fee of 13.25% on total buyer payment up to $7,500 per item and 2.35% thereafter (12.35% for Basic+ Store subscribers). Fixed per-order fee structured at $0.30 for orders $10.00 or under, and $0.40 for orders over $10.00.

Maintained 6.5% transaction fee applied to item price and shipping collected, $0.20 listing renewals every 4 months, 3.0% + $0.25 payment processing, and mandatory 12% offsite ads for shops with >$10k annual sales.
category_impact: Handmade, craft supplies, and vintage items

what_changed: Standardized 8.0% commission on hammer auction price, plus 2.9% + $0.30 payment processing fee applied to the total transaction amount paid by the buyer.
category_impact: Livestream auction sales across collectibles, cards, and fashion

what_changed: Confirmed streamer payout rate of $0.01 USD per bit received with a $50 minimum cashout threshold. Viewer bundle purchasing prices remain ~40% above payout value.
